name: Sputnik Climbing Asturias

coord_source.ref: place pin of the Google Maps link on the gym's own centre page (maps.app.goo.gl/EcPzxFuphztYdXWx9, !3d43.4077004!4d-5.8015733); the Google listing still says "Proximamente" but the site and press say it is open

research_notes: Centre page (read 2026-10-05) says "ESTAMOS ABIERTOS", Mon-Sat 10-22, Sun/holidays 10-21:30; 500 m2 of bouldering (about 100 problems on two floors), Quantum Board XL, about 100 rope routes, 40 auto-belays, speed wall. Press (El Fielato 2026-09-25) reports the opening on Fri 25 Sep 2026. Nominatim has the street Avenida del Peralon (43.4082,-5.8022) about 70 m from the pin; no OSM element for the gym yet.

name: Boulder Up Climbing Café
research_notes: Own site: hours Mon-Fri 10:30-14 and 16:30-22, Sat 10:30-20, Sun 10:30-15; facilities page: 1,000 m2, more than 80 boulder problems and 25 rope lines with auto-belay, free intro boulder course. OSM node is tagged leisure=sports_centre with address 245 Calle Alexander Graham Bell and website boulderup.es.

name: One Move

coord_source.ref: latitude/longitude published in the structured data (geo) of the gym's own home page

research_notes: Own site: more than 1,500 m2 with sport-climbing walls, boulder, school, cafe and gym; hours Mon-Fri 10-14:30 and 16:30-22:30, Sat 10-21:30, Sun 10-14:30; courses include a "circuito de bulder (escalada en bloque)". No OSM element. The pin comes from the site structured data and is about 200 m north of the Nominatim centre of Calle Esperanza (43.5314,-5.6966), so it is kept street-level.

name: Boulder Moss Club de Escalada
address: Camín del Molín del Río 16, 33391 Gijón (Granda)
research_notes: Own site: hall with overhanging boulder panels at 15, 25, 30, 40 and 50 degrees, MoonBoard, system board, campus board and gym equipment; rates page: day pass for non-members 8 EUR, open 6-24 h seven days a week (member key access). No rope walls mentioned, so type stays bouldering only.

name: Torresamper Climbing Center
research_notes: Own rocodromo page: traverse wall with overhangs plus "bloques de variada dificultad, ideales para escalar de manera libre", MoonBoard 2024 and Clifft Board; hours Mon-Fri 10-14 and 16:30-22; the contact page publishes Calle Juan Valera 14 and a Google Maps pin (43.3731086,-5.8515192) that agrees with the OSM node within 15 m. Also a physiotherapy clinic and personal training centre. No rope climbing mentioned.

name: Climbat Avilés

coord_source.ref: GPS 43.54417 / -5.88306 printed on the gym's own centre page

research_notes: Own page: "Boulder, vias autoaseguradas y vias de cuerda", more than 1,000 m2 at Parque Astur shopping centre, hours Mon 11-22, Tue closed, Wed-Fri 11-22, Sat-Sun 10-21, courses "Nivel 1 Bloque" / "Nivel 2 Cuerda". CAUTION: the GPS printed on the page is about 1 km west of the Parque Astur shopping area where OSM puts the other "50, Enllaz de Tresona" businesses (Carrefour 43.5465,-5.8708); no OSM element for Climbat. Pin is therefore only street-level and may be wrong.

name: El Roko
research_notes: Own site: open 10-22 daily, day entry 9 EUR, courses and school; rope use needs contact. The only boulder mention on the site is a 2020 news post "Copa de Asturias de Boulder 2019"; no page describes a boulder area. Press/directories say it has a boulder room but those are not primary. OSM way is named El Roko at Calle Ronda 2 (the building has a second address).

name: Rocódromo La Calzada (Mata Jove)
address: Pabellón Mata Jove, La Calzada, Gijón
research_notes: Municipal sports-hall climbing facility (Gijon city council directory): 300 m2 main wall, 165 m2 initiation wall and a 9 x 3.5 m boulder wall (45 m2, about 45 degree overhang); prior reservation needed through the igijon app or citizen kiosks; hours Oct-May Mon-Fri 9-23, Sat 9-14 and 16-21, Sun 9-14. Read through a search-result excerpt of the council page (the page itself renders by script), so wording is not independently re-read.
